s1.syndrome_frame: Fetal neurological abnormalities with ventriculomegaly and irregular ventricular walls
salient_findings: Multiple hyperechoic regions within the ventricular lumens
key_facts: Normal middle cerebral artery perfusion on fetal Doppler ultrasound
Bilateral ventricular enlargement on fetal MRI
Areas of high signal intensity on T1-weighted images and low signal intensity on T2-weighted images within the ventricles
Comprehensive workup returned within normal limits

shortlist.label: Congenital Cytomegalovirus Infection
shortlist.why_kept: Fetal neurological abnormalities with ventriculomegaly and irregular ventricular walls, consistent with congenital infection

shortlist.label: Congenital Toxoplasmosis
shortlist.why_kept: Fetal neurological abnormalities with ventriculomegaly and irregular ventricular walls, consistent with congenital infection

shortlist.label: Dandy-Walker Malformation
shortlist.why_kept: Bilateral ventricular enlargement and irregular ventricular walls, consistent with Dandy-Walker malformation

shortlist.label: Lissencephaly
shortlist.why_kept: Fetal neurological abnormalities with ventriculomegaly and irregular ventricular walls, consistent with lissencephaly

shortlist.label: Schizencephaly
shortlist.why_kept: Fetal neurological abnormalities with ventriculomegaly and irregular ventricular walls, consistent with schizencephaly

raw.rationale: The presence of bilateral ventriculomegaly, irregular ventricular walls, and multiple hyperechoic regions within the ventricular lumens, along with areas of high signal intensity on T1-weighted images and low signal intensity on T2-weighted images within the ventricles on fetal MRI, are consistent with the findings of congenital CMV infection, which can cause ventriculomegaly and periventricular calcifications.

rejected.label: Congenital Toxoplasmosis
rejected.why: Although congenital toxoplasmosis can cause ventriculomegaly, the normal comprehensive workup, including a TORCH panel, makes this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Dandy-Walker Malformation
rejected.why: Dandy-Walker malformation typically presents with hypoplasia of the cerebellar vermis and cystic dilation of the fourth ventricle, which is not described in the vignette.

rejected.label: Lissencephaly
rejected.why: Lissencephaly is characterized by a smooth brain surface and thickened cortex, which is not consistent with the ultrasound and MRI findings in this case.

rejected.label: Schizencephaly
rejected.why: Schizencephaly typically presents with full-thickness clefts in the cerebral hemispheres, which is not described in the vignette.
